dict.string: EmergencyMesh uses Bluetooth to discover and maintain peer-to-peer mesh connectivity offline.
EmergencyMesh uses local network Wi-Fi/P2P to communicate with nearby devices.
EmergencyMesh analyzes ambient sound waves in RAM to classify emergencies like alarms or screams.
EmergencyMesh uses Ultra Wideband to point directly to distressed peers.
EmergencyMesh uses Ultra Wideband to locate nearby peers in an emergency.
